name: CapCut
desc: ByteDance's video editor, including AI generation and editing.
desc_zh: 字节跳动出海的 AI 剪辑工具，即剪映国际版

solves_zh: 让人在手机上直接剪完一条短视频，不必学桌面剪辑软件。
best_for: You are making vertical video for social and want AI captions and templates built in.
best_for_zh: 做竖屏短视频、需要自带字幕和模板时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：Apple App Store US Photo & Video Top Free #1。来源：https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/charts/6008
